description: Restructure exact batch-640 n=512 shared staging around an SM100 TMA or software-swizzled layout compatible with MathDx LD36/LD40 operands, targeting the exact profile's 2.4-way stores, 21% excessive shared wavefronts, 32.5% short-scoreboard delay, and 29.20 KiB footprint. Preserve compact logical sidecar slots, legal bulk/mbarrier reuse, the many-CTA n=1024 solve, aliased n=2048 wavefront, every other dispatch, caller-stream semantics, caches, fresh inputs, and the full grid.

Profile-driven single-bank n512 staging: cut dynamic shared storage from the exact capture's 29.20 KiB to about 21.70 KiB by collapsing six LD40 factor tiles to one three-tile bank, while preserving compact logical slots, the legal contiguous 2.5+5 KiB bulk transfers, one phase-tracked mbarrier, LD36 MathDx operands, and every other parent dispatch. The slice-wrapped build, all 17 official tests, fresh-input guard, and full 15-cell grid passed. Batch640 n512 measured 1026.601 us versus parent 968.926 us and aggregate measured 833.097 us versus parent 824.561 us; n1024/n2048 sampled 1054.374/1922.575 us. No hosted profile request was launched because the manager has not granted quota.

Replaced n512's regular LD40 MathDx shared operands with cuBLASDx SM100 suggested swizzled A/B layouts, converted the compact global LD40 sidecar through layout-aware copies, retained paired-panel A reuse, and moved rank-k accumulation into per-thread fragments before publishing to unchanged LD36 POTRF/TRSM tiles; nominal dynamic shared storage fell to about 19.5 KiB. Slice-wrapped build and all 17 official tests plus fresh-input guard passed because those do not instantiate exact batch640 n512, but the complete locked grid's batch640 n512 cell produced NaN/Inf after lazy specialization, so no aggregate metric is available. Every other measured cell remained valid. No hosted profile request was launched without manager grant.

Corrected Trial1's accumulating-product error by clearing the cuBLASDx product accumulator before every tensor-API MMA, holding all other swizzled-layout code fixed. The exact batch640 specialization now passed: compact global LD40 factor tiles were transformed into SM100 suggested 2 KiB A/B swizzles, paired panels reused one A copy, products were combined in register fragments, and results were published to unchanged LD36 POTRF/TRSM tiles at about 19.5 KiB dynamic shared storage. Slice-wrapped build, all 17 tests, fresh-input guard, and all 15 cells passed. Batch640 n512 measured 5897.453 us versus 1026.601 for single-bank Trial0 and parent 968.926; aggregate measured 936.409 us versus 833.097/824.561. The large cost quantifies layout-copy and fragment import/export overhead despite the smaller footprint. No hosted request was launched without manager grant.

Kept Trial2's correct SM100 opaque MathDx operands, accumulator clearing, paired-panel reuse, and 19.5 KiB footprint, but replaced generic layout-aware factor copies with a direct cooperative Swizzle<2,3,3> mapping inferred from the public 128x128 example. Slice-wrapped build and normal validation/guard passed, while the locked exact batch640 n512 cell produced NaN/Inf, proving that inferred physical permutation does not match this 32x32 descriptor's opaque A/B layouts. No aggregate metric is available and no hosted profile request was launched.

Corrected Trial3's software mapping from a slice-wrapped compile-only extraction of the exact cuBLASDx 32x32 tensor types: A is Swizzle<2,3,3> over ((32,1),(8,4)) strides ((1,1),(32,256)); B is the same swizzle over ((8,4),(32,1)) strides ((32,256),(1,1)); both reduce the compact LD40 source to (p>>5)*40+(p&31). Slice-wrapped build and all 17 tests plus fresh-input guard passed, but the full locked benchmark emitted no result for 2906.620 s—over twice the 1200 s ranked budget and beyond the run's previous 2270 s hang threshold—so the wrapped Modal job was terminated and no metric is available. This exact physical mapping therefore incurred a live runtime hang under batch640 n512. No hosted profile request was launched.

Closed after five logged trials on selected commit cc7b8a35a368776f1495e69a5681940332e8c92a, which passed all checks at 833.097 us aggregate and 1026.601 us batch640/n512. Opaque/swizzled MathDx layouts measured 936.409/5897.453 us when correct, while direct mappings produced NaN/Inf or a 2906.620-second runtime hang. A subsequent Trial5 built and validated but its benchmark session was never collected after the worker lost its brief role during compaction, so no metric was logged. No hosted request was consumed.
